# Install and load packgages

```{r}
#| warning: false

packages <- c(
    "renv",
    "dplyr",
    "purrr",
    "here",
    "tidyr",
    "MetBrewer",
    "ggplot2",
    "patchwork",
    "magrittr",
    "ComplexHeatmap",
    # Single Cell
    "Seurat"
)
# Install
installed_packages <- packages %in%
    rownames(installed.packages())
if (any(installed_packages == F)) {
    install.packages(packages[!installed_packages])
}
# Load
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    invisible(lapply(packages, library, character.only = T))
})
```

# Create project-local library

```{r}
#| eval: false

# Call renv
renv::init()
# If you add new libraries perform an snapshot
renv::snapshot()
```

# Set working directory

```{r}
directory <- here::here()
```

# Helper functions for QC

```{r}
.processing_objects <- function(SEURAT_OBJECT, 
                                MIN_FEATURES, 
                                MAX_FEATURES, 
                                PERCENT_MT = NULL) {
    #' Preprocess Seurat object by applying QC metrics
    #'
    #' @param SEURAT_OBJECT Seurat object to preprocess
    #' @param MIN_FEATURES Minimum number of detected features per cell
    #' @param MAX_FEATURES Maximum number of detected features per cell
    #' @param PERCENT_MT Maximum allowed mitochondrial percentage per cell (`NULL` by default)
    #' @return Filtered Seurat object

    SEURAT_OBJECT <- subset(
        SEURAT_OBJECT,
        subset = nFeature_RNA > MIN_FEATURES
        & nFeature_RNA < MAX_FEATURES
        & percent.mt < PERCENT_MT
    )

    SEURAT_OBJECT
}

.normalizing_plus_hvFeatures <- function(SEURAT_OBJECT) {
    #' Apply normalization and find Highly Variable Features
    #'
    #' @param SEURAT_OBJECT
    #' @comment default argument in use
    #' @return SEURAT_OBJECT
    
    SEURAT_OBJECT <- Seurat::NormalizeData(
        SEURAT_OBJECT,
        normalization.method = "LogNormalize",
        scale.factor = 10000
    )

    SEURAT_OBJECT <- Seurat::FindVariableFeatures(
        SEURAT_OBJECT, 
        selection.method = "vst",
        nfeatures = 2000
    )

    SEURAT_OBJECT
}

.dim_heatmap_ch <- function(
    SEURAT_OBJECT,
    P_COMP = NULL,
    N_GENES = NULL,
    TITLE = NULL) {
    #' Plot heatmap to identify source of heterogeneity
    #'
    #' @param SEURAT_OBJECT Seurat object post PCA and feature identification
    #' @param P_COMP Principal component to plot (integer)
    #' @param N_GENES Number of top and bottom genes by PC loading score
    #' @param TITLE String for the heatmap title
    #' @return ComplexHeatmap object

    # Extract PC loadings and select top/bottom N genes
    LOADINGS <- Seurat::Loadings(SEURAT_OBJECT, reduction = "pca")[, P_COMP]
    TOP_GENES <- names(sort(LOADINGS, decreasing = TRUE)[1:N_GENES])
    BOTTOM_GENES <- names(sort(LOADINGS, decreasing = FALSE)[1:N_GENES])
    SELECTED_GENES <- c(TOP_GENES, BOTTOM_GENES)

    # Sort cells by PC embedding score — this is what creates visible blocks
    EMBEDDINGS <- Seurat::Embeddings(SEURAT_OBJECT, reduction = "pca")[, P_COMP]
    SORTED_CELLS <- names(sort(EMBEDDINGS, decreasing = TRUE))

    # Extract scaled expression matrix — genes as rows, sorted cells as columns
    MATRIX <- Seurat::GetAssayData(
        SEURAT_OBJECT,
        layer = "scale.data"
    )[SELECTED_GENES, SORTED_CELLS]

    # Cell metadata annotation (color bar on top)
    CELL_IDENTITY <- as.factor(Seurat::Idents(SEURAT_OBJECT))[SORTED_CELLS]
    ANNOTATION_COLORS <- setNames(
        MetBrewer::met.brewer("Redon", length(levels(CELL_IDENTITY))),
        levels(CELL_IDENTITY)
    )
    TOP_ANNOTATION <- ComplexHeatmap::HeatmapAnnotation(
        Identity = CELL_IDENTITY,
        col = list(Identity = ANNOTATION_COLORS)
    )

    # Plot
    HT <- ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(
        matrix = MATRIX,
        name = "Scaled Expression",
        column_title = TITLE,
        top_annotation = TOP_ANNOTATION,
        cluster_rows = FALSE,
        cluster_columns = FALSE,
        show_column_names = FALSE,
        show_row_names = TRUE,
        row_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 8)
    )

    FN <- function() ComplexHeatmap::draw(HT)
    ggplotify::as.ggplot(FN)
}
```

# Load, generate and process Seurat object

```{r}
# Load the PBMC dataset
pbmc.data <- Seurat::Read10X(data.dir = file.path(
    directory,
    "inputs/filtered_gene_bc_matrices/hg19/"
))

# Initialize the Seurat object with the raw (non-normalized data).
pbmc <- Seurat::CreateSeuratObject(
    counts = pbmc.data, 
    project = "pbmc3k", 
    min.cells = 3, 
    min.features = 200
)

# Mitochondrial genes
pbmc[["percent.mt"]] <- Seurat::PercentageFeatureSet(
        pbmc, pattern = "^MT-"
)

# Save
# saveRDS(
#     pbmc,
#     file.path(
#         directory,
#         "outputs", 
#         "00_exploratory",
#         paste0(format(Sys.Date(), "%b_%d_%Y"), "_pbmc_seurat_raw.rds")
#     )
# )

# Plot features for QC metrics
.violin_plot <- Seurat::VlnPlot(
    pbmc,
    features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"),
    ncol = 3,
    pt.size = 0.1,
    cols = rep("#ab3329", 3)
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme(
        aspect.ratio = 1,
        plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(hjust = 0.5)
    )

# Plot feature-feature relationships
.feature_plot_1 <- Seurat::FeatureScatter(
    pbmc,
    feature1 = "nCount_RNA",
    feature2 = "percent.mt",
    cols = "#ab3329"
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme(
        aspect.ratio = 1,
        plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(hjust = 0.5)
    )

.feature_plot_2 <- Seurat::FeatureScatter(
    pbmc,
    feature1 = "nCount_RNA",
    feature2 = "nFeature_RNA",
    cols = "#ab3329"
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme(
        aspect.ratio = 1,
        plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(hjust = 0.5)
    )

# Save
# .tiff_pdf_plot(
#     PLOT = .violin_plot / (.feature_plot_1 + .feature_plot_2),
#     HEIGHT = 8,
#     WIDTH = 8,
#     DIRECTORY = file.path(directory, 
#     "plots", 
#     "00_exploratory"),
#     FILENAME = paste0(format(Sys.Date(), 
#     "%b_%d_%Y"), 
#     "_pbmc_qc_violin_plus_features")
# )

# Apply processing function
pbmc %<>% 
    .processing_objects(
        MIN_FEATURES = 200,
        MAX_FEATURES = 2500,
        PERCENT_MT = 5)

# Normalize and find variab le features
pbmc %<>%
    .normalizing_plus_hvFeatures()

# Save
# saveRDS(
#     pbmc,
#     file.path(
#         directory,
#         "outputs",
#         "00_exploratory",
#         paste0(format(Sys.Date(), "%b_%d_%Y"), 
#         "_pbmc_normalized_hvFeatures.rds")
#     )
# )

# plot variable features with and without labels
.hvFeatures_1 <- Seurat::VariableFeaturePlot(pbmc)
.hvFeatures_2 <- Seurat::LabelPoints(
    plot = .hvFeatures_1, 
    # Top 10
    points =  head(VariableFeatures(pbmc), 10), 
    repel = T)

# Save
# .tiff_pdf_plot(
#     PLOT = .hvFeatures_1 + .hvFeatures_2,
#     HEIGHT = 10,
#     WIDTH = 10,
#     DIRECTORY = file.path(directory,

#     "00_exploratory"),
#     FILENAME = paste0(format(Sys.Date(), 
#     "%b_%d_%Y"), 
#     "_pbmc_hvFeatures")
# )

# Scale data
pbmc %<>% Seurat::ScaleData( 
    features = rownames(pbmc)) %>%
        Seurat::RunPCA(
            features = Seurat::VariableFeatures(object = pbmc))

# Dimensional reduction
.dim_loadings_pc <- lapply(1:3, function(i) {
    Seurat::VizDimLoadings(
        pbmc, 
        dims = i, 
        reduction = "pca", 
        col = "#ab3329") +
        ggplot2::xlab(paste0("PC", i)) +
        ggplot2::theme(
            aspect.ratio = 2,
            plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(hjust = 0.5)
        )
}) %>% patchwork::wrap_plots()

# Heatmap of Principal Component X
.pc_heatmap <- .dim_heatmap_ch(
    pbmc,
    P_COMP = 1,
    # Default (top 15, positive and negative)
    N_GENES = 30,
    TITLE = "Top genes PC1",
    TOP_ANNOTATION = FALSE
)

# Save 
fs::dir_create(path = file.path(
    directory, 
    "plots/00_exploratory/dim_red_PCs/"))
```
